mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operational_period ( id, incident_id, sequence_number, status, reason, reason_memo, started_by_account_id, ended_by_account_id, started_at, ended_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{sequenceNumber}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{reasonMemo}, #{startedByAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{endedByAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM operational_period WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM operational_period WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY sequence_number ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE operational_period SET status = 'ENDED', ended_by_account_id = #{endedByAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, ended_at = #{endedAt}, version = #{version}, updated_at = #{endedAt} WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
